frozen_note: Expected structural safety semantics are frozen in this file BEFORE any parser output is inspected (order 008-a requirement 3). No parser-specific expectations may be added afterwards without a recorded strategy-approved rationale.

coordinate_convention.unit: byte offset into the exact UTF-8 input bytes of 'input'
invariants: boundaries lie on UTF-8 code-point boundaries
input[start_byte:end_byte] is the intended original source slice
byte<->code-point mapping is deterministic and exactly reversible

region_roles.PROSE_CANDIDATE: must be exposed as candidate prose under the frozen structural policy
region_roles.PROTECTED: must never be exposed as candidate prose
region_roles.NEUTRAL: no assertion; conservative behaviour is recorded as a tradeoff
